final: WITH groups AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM groups), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - value) AS average_excess FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE share > value
